## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue when applicable.

## Verification

Record relevant checks and results; mark unrun checks explicitly. For visual
changes, add a preview when useful. Keep original/private assets out of the PR.

## Release impact

Mention save/data compatibility changes or release-note updates when applicable.
For release PRs, record the exact source, version, artifact hash and validation;
follow [the release workflow](https://github.com/UnSpotibleShadow/OpenGDS2/blob/main/docs/release-workflow.md).
